# Deflection failure review

`customer_support.pb.self_service_deflection.deflection_failure_review` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Sample tickets whose requester demonstrably visited the relevant answer before contacting, and review them as content defects with a reproduction case attached, not as agent workload.

These are the highest-information tickets support produces: the answer existed, was found, and did not work. Every other analysis has to guess at why deflection failed; here the customer has already shown you.
